nodes.title: Before writing Next.js code
nodes.body: 1. Read `docs/agent/architecture/nextjs-critical-fixes.md` for full patterns 2. Check existing components in `apps/frontend/components/` for examples

nodes.title: Waterfalls
nodes.body: - Use `Promise.all()` for independent fetches - Wrap slow data in `<Suspense>` boundaries - Defer `await` into branches where needed

nodes.title: Bundle Size
nodes.body: - NO barrel imports: `import X from 'lucide-react'` ❌ - YES direct imports: `import X from 'lucide-react/dist/esm/icons/x'` ✅ - Use `next/dynamic` for heavy components (editors, charts, PDF viewers) - Defer analytics with `ssr: false`

nodes.title: Server Actions
nodes.body: - ALWAYS check auth INSIDE the action, not just middleware - Verify resource ownership before mutations

nodes.title: Production Build
nodes.body: - Users run `npm run build && npm run start`, NOT `npm run dev` - Docker must use standalone output, not dev mode

nodes.title: Quick Check Before PR
nodes.body: ``` [ ] No sequential awaits for independent data [ ] Icons imported directly [ ] Heavy components use next/dynamic [ ] Server Actions have auth inside [ ] Suspense around slow fetches ```
